name: Music Theatre Philly Summer Stock
street_address: The Arts Bank, 601 S. Broad Street
description_short: Multi week musical theater intensives at the Arts Bank theater on South Broad Street. Rising grades 4 to 8 rehearse and stage a junior musical in two weeks, from auditions to sets and costumes; rising grades 9 to 12 train in three or four week evening intensives built around a full production.

fees.name: After care, grades 4 to 8
fees.note: 4 to 5:30 p.m. Monday to Thursday; $20 a day; none on Fridays

refund_policy_summary: Full refund less a $25 registration fee per class if cancelled more than two weeks before the session; 50% refund less the $25 within two weeks; no refund once the session starts.

sessions.name: Into the Woods Jr. vocal intensive (grades 9 to 12)
Much Ado acting intensive, by audition (grades 9 to 12)
Newsies Jr. dance technique intensive (grades 9 to 12)

notes: Grades 4 to 8 run 9 a.m. to 4 p.m. at $1,250 per two week camp. Grades 9 to 12 run 4 to 8 p.m. at $975 (three weeks) or $1,150 (four week Much Ado, by audition). 20% off with code EARLYBIRD27 before January 1, 2027; sibling and multi camp discounts. Campers pack food. Performances are at the Arts Bank Theatre on the second Friday of each camp.
